original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: SPR binding assays were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. The His6/FLAG-tagged TEV fused ATAD2 bromodomain (950 to 1148 residues) was immobilized on the chip via amine coupling. The protein was expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) cells and purified as described previously.20 The running buffer was 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.005% P20, 0.05% Tween 20. Compounds were diluted in the running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM. The association phase lasted 120 s, followed by a 120 s dissociation phase. The chip was regenerated with 10 mM glycine, pH 2.0, for 30 s. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 Evaluation Software v3.0. The binding affinity (KD) was determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
